# REST operations

<!-- Generated by scripts/maintain_skills.py from the dlm binary. Do not edit. -->

All operations of the daemon, grouped by resource. The operation ID is also
the name in `dlm openapi`, where the full request and response schemas are.

## auth

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/v1/auth/token/rotate` | `rotate-token` | Replace the primary token |
| GET | `/v1/auth/tokens` | `list-tokens` | List named tokens |
| POST | `/v1/auth/tokens` | `create-token` | Create a named token |
| DELETE | `/v1/auth/tokens/{id}` | `delete-token` | Revoke a named token |
| GET | `/v1/auth/whoami` | `whoami` | Who am I |
